front_blocks.md: Which three factors cause **population change**?

back_blocks.md: Population change results from **birth rates**, **death rates** and **migration**.

cards.front_md: Which three factors cause **population change**?

front_blocks.md: Why are **birth rates** often higher in LICs?

back_blocks.md: Birth rates are often higher in LICs because of **limited access to contraception** and **family planning**.

cards.front_md: Why are **birth rates** often higher in LICs?
cards.back_md: Birth rates are often higher in LICs because of **limited access to contraception** and **family planning**.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
In many HICs, birth rates are high because more women are educated.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
Birth rates in many HICs are **low**, because women are more likely to **work**, be **educated**, **delay marriage** and have fewer children.

**False.**

cards.front_md: Which improvements **reduce death rates**?

front_blocks.md: What pushes people out of **rural areas** in rural-urban migration?

cards.front_md: What pushes people out of **rural areas** in rural-urban migration?

front_blocks.md: Which problems can **fast urban growth** cause?

back_blocks.md: Fast urban growth can cause **overcrowding**, **housing shortages** and **pressure on services**.

cards.front_md: Which problems can **fast urban growth** cause?

front_blocks.md: How does rising **food demand** affect land?
